executive_summary: The business recorded a total of 591 orders yielding 67,580,017.8 in total sales, 50,178,983.78 in total cost, and 17,401,034.02 in total profit, resulting in an overall profit margin of 25.75% and an average order value of 114,348.59 across 2,075 total quantity sold.
strongest_area: Karachi region is the strongest area in terms of sales (24,608,300.33), profit (6,182,825.63), quantity (672), and orders (193), while Electronics is the highest-grossing category with 34,351,369.6 in sales and 8,085,463.3 in profit. Clothing holds the highest category profit margin at 37.8%.
weakest_area: Office Supplies is the weakest category in terms of total sales (1,613,347.98) and total profit (490,635.47), while Multan is the lowest region by sales (4,868,191.25) and orders (54) among named regions.
key_insights: Electronics dominates category sales, contributing 34,351,369.6 out of the 67,580,017.8 total sales.
Karachi leads all regions, generating nearly half of the total volume and substantial financial returns with 193 orders and 672 total quantity sold.
Clothing and Office Supplies achieve high profit margins at 37.8% and 30.41% respectively, despite lower total sales.
risks: There are unassigned or 'Unknown' regions and categories generating sales (2,751,983.87 in Unknown regions and 1,884,348.72 in Unknown categories), which points to data tracking and tracking integrity issues.
Business performance is heavily concentrated in Karachi and Electronics, exposing operations to geographic and product-specific vulnerabilities.
recommendations: Investigate and resolve data tracking issues to properly categorize transactions currently marked as 'Unknown' for region and category.
Evaluate the high-margin Clothing and Office Supplies categories to see if marketing efforts can be expanded to increase their total sales volume.
